title: Parsimony and Ablation Audit for Graph Classifier

verdict.summary: KEEP SIMPLE BASELINE: 1-layer linear head matches the 4-module stack within 0.003 macro-F1 [run_logs/ablation_5seeds.json]. Ablating three added modules shows 0.741 vs 0.744 (+0.003, p=0.62).

parsimony_check.simplest_alternative: 1-layer linear head (0 extra attention or contrastive losses)
parsimony_check.rationale: 0.741 (1-layer linear head) vs 0.744 (4-module stack), +0.003 across 5 seeds

key_evidence.claim: 1-layer linear head achieves 0.741 macro-F1 across 5 fixed seeds.
Full 4-module stack reaches 0.744 macro-F1 (+0.003 gain, 3.2x latency).

flaws_and_risks.summary: Three added modules add 3.2x inference latency with no measurable gain (+0.003, p=0.62).

next_steps.action: Drop the three unverified modules and deploy the 1-layer linear head.
